inputs.original_text: They’re making an example of someone who probed the machinery: people focus on the charges, then dismiss the group as purveyors of “false election claims.” Harry Wait requested ballots for Robin Vos and Cory Mason without consent. The jury convicted him of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge, while acquitting him of another identity theft count. That split outcome doesn’t erase the bigger issue: he said he was demonstrating that the registration system could be exploited. The institutions benefit when people see that testing the system can bring serious consequences, and when scrutiny itself is treated as the threat.
